script_text: Pisces, the heavens are conspiring to bring profound changes, and you must prepare for what's coming in your life very soon now. On Monday, Mars squares Neptune, creating tension in your 7th House of partnerships. Tuesday brings a Jupiter trine to your 1st House, boosting confidence and initiative. Midweek, Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance, while Mercury sextiles your 10th House, signaling career advancement. On Thursday, the Sun opposes Neptune, casting a dreamy glow over your 9th House of travel. By Friday, Saturn squares your 3rd House, challenging communication but grounding your ideas. Wednesday is your best day as Venus rules your 5th House, amplifying love and creativity. Monday is the most challenging because Mars squares Neptune, stirring conflict in partnerships. Embrace your water element and let intuition guide your decisions this week. Follow for daily updates and stay connected to the cosmic flow.
